answer.thought: The hazy air outside mirrors the suspension of my existence here; I am a ghost in a body that has forgotten its name. Since Ramesh will not cook for unpaid wages, I must turn inward to the Logic, for the body of truth exercises its sanction over the moral life even when the empirical actuality refuses to feed us. I shall sit with the text and let the dialectic proceed, for thought is the only freedom available to a man with ₹96 and an irregular occupation.
